summary: Shop Tabs feature-3 iteration 225: (1) new POST /api/supplier-sync/shop-tab-destinations/create endpoint, (2) Destination column on Manager tables, (3) Quick Edit Shop Tabs panel, (4) '+ New tab' shortcut inside the bulk Shop Tabs modal. All 8 pytest tests pass (5 existing + 3 new for create endpoint covering success + verification in mongo + duplicate 409 + empty label 400 + unknown group 404). Full UI E2E on /admin/materials verified: Shop Tabs column shows 138 cells (green chips + amber 'none' pills), Quick Edit drawer's sky-blue Shop Tabs panel with 6 grouped options (tiles/flooring/materials Cleaning & Maintenance fixture KEPT), staged-change header text 'N destination(s) · unsaved changes' works, Save Changes fires quick-update+bulk-update+assign-shop-tabs chain and the destination chips in the parent table refresh via fetchProducts (add + reopen + untick + restore round-trip completed on SKU 8205N, baseline FLOOR TILES restored). New-tab modal shortcut renders '+ New tab' per section (tiles/flooring/materials), inline form appears on click, Create call adds tab to Flooring section auto-ticked green with '+1 destination' summary. All mutations restored (mongo cleanup of e2e-ui-tab category + shop_flooring nav item; e2e-test-tab restored by the pytest fixture itself).
critical_code_review_comments: create_shop_tab: cat_slug derived by simple regex; two labels with same alnum-slug (e.g. 'Foo' vs 'FOO!') collide silently on an existing website_categories doc and just reuse it. Fine today but worth logging when existing_cat is found for a different display name.
create_shop_tab writes to navigation_menus and website_categories but no transactional rollback — if the second write fails after the first, DB is left half-updated. Non-critical for MVP.

shopTabDestinations.js uses a module-level cache — table destination chips will NOT reflect newly created tabs until a full reload. Behaviour is intentional per E1's note; may confuse users who expect the parent-table chip labels to appear immediately after creating a new tab in the modal (only auto-refreshes on the row-level assignment endpoint).

supplier_sync.py is now >14.8k lines. Shop Tabs endpoints (get_shop_tab_destinations, assign_shop_tabs, create_shop_tab, DEFAULT_TILES_SHOP_MENU) should be extracted into a dedicated router module for maintainability.
Repeated 403 GETs on /api/analytics/* and 404 on some background resource in console — unrelated to this feature but worth cleanup.

Testids: materials-desttabs-{SKU} (chip cell), shop-tabs-panel-toggle (QE drawer collapsible header — text is 'Shop Tabs where it appears' when collapsed and 'Shop Tabs N destinations · unsaved changes' after ticks), qe-shop-tab-option-{group}-{cat_slug} (QE options), shop-tabs-new-tab-btn-{group} + shop-tabs-new-tab-form-{group} (bulk modal shortcut), shop-tab-option-{group}-{cat_slug} (bulk modal option), shop-tabs-change-summary.
